segments.text: I WISH to answer your last in person. I hope the time is now drawing near. I count the weeks, and days, and hours. LORD JESUS, direct my goings in thy way. Blessed be GOD that you live in such harmony! A house thus united in JESUS, will stand. I shall bring only one Mr. W――――t, who takes care of me. I would not have Mr. H――――s to think of stirring till he sees me. This I write in great haste. I am enabled to preach once a day. Give thanks! give thanks! and continue to pray for, dear Mrs. C――――,
